 Product Description
[Daekyung Tech] Brinell hardness tester (DTB-600N)
Quote Contact_cs@roasexpo.com
It is a hydraulic Brinell hardness tester that tests by pressing the indenter of a steel ball into a specimen under a constant test load.
-Main functions and features
ㆍEasy to operate with one touch until the test is completed.
ㆍLoad maintenance and load removal are automatically operated.
ㆍLoad holding time is automatically controlled by digital timer.
ㆍWhen the load is maintained, the load drop phenomenon hardly occurs.
ㆍIn continuous operation, measurement time is shortened and individual errors do not occur.
-Basic accessories
Instrumentation microscope: 1 pc.
Test weight: 8 pieces (A, B, C, D)
Ball indenter: 2 tungsten balls (10mm, 5mm)
Spare steel ball: 1 each (10mm, 5mm)
Anvil : 2ea (60 mm, V-set)
Steel box: 1
Cloth cover: 1
Test load: 500,750,1000,1500,2000,2500,3000(kgf)
Machine size: 470X600X1140(mm)
Maximum test height: 175mm
Weight: about 120 kg
